text: Core courses Human Anatomy, Human Physiology, Health Science of Sports, Sports Psychology, School Sports, Sports Psychology, Outline of Sports, Sports Anatomy, Sports Physiology, Sports Biomechanics, Sports Biochemistry, Methods of Sports Scientific Research, Sports Statistics, Sports Pedagogy, Sports Curriculum and Teaching Theory, Design of Sports Teaching, and Principle of Sports Studies. Objective This objective is to train students to grasp the basic theory, knowledge and technical ability of physical education and have strong practice ability. On the basis of all-round development, students each are required to have professional specialties and are able to work in intermediate schools and schools of higher learning to teach sports courses, manage school’s sports activities, take charge of extracurricular sports activity training, or serve as community sports instructors. At the same time they should be able to be engaged in sport contest affairs or serve as sport referees. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Education is granted.
